text:
Kai Moreno: Morning all — excited to join Redwood! Laptop arrived. Quick wins I need: 1) MFA set up for SSO keeps failing on my phone; 2) SSH to jumpbox gives 'Permission denied (publickey)'; 3) if I ever swing by SF later, wheres badge pickup? Fun fact: I have a parrot named Pixel who types better than I do.
Nina Park: Welcome Kai!! :tada: Im your buddy for the month. For SF badges go to Lobby B (9-4) with photo ID, we can also ship a visitor sticker if youre remote.
Jules Ortiz: Hi Kai — for MFA try removing the existing auth app entry and re-registering the device. If you see a clock-skew issue on the TOTP code, sync your phone clock or use the backup codes we emailed.
mdm-bot: Reminder: Company VPN requires device enrollment in CompanyMDM. To enroll: install CompanyMDM, sign in with @redwood.com, enter emailed code. Wait 5-10 minutes for policies. Reply "enrolled" when done.
it-bot: SSH & key checklist: 1) ensure public key uploaded to GitLab (Profile > SSH Keys); 2) `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` or correct key file; 3) MDM enrolled and VPN connected. If blocked, post `ssh -v` output (mask hostnames).
Kai Moreno: Thanks — trying MFA re-register now, installing MDM next. Small wrinkle: Im in CET so mostly async is great.
Nina Park: Totally fine. Ill post a Loom walkthrough for repo setup and add you to #new-hires and #ml-team. Also pro tip: search the onboarding doc for "first week checklist".
Kai Moreno: Enrolled in MDM and added my pubkey to GitLab. Re-ran `ssh -v` and still get permission denied. Sending the output to Nina in a DM.
Jules Ortiz: If `ssh -v` shows a key mismatch, check the key fingerprint on GitLab vs `ssh-keygen -lf ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`. Also confirm you didn't accidentally upload the private key.
doorbot: FYI — if you visit SF, badge pickup sometimes queues. Expect 10-20 minute wait during morning hours.
Kai Moreno: All set for now. MFA fixed (cleared app + re-enroll helped), MDM enrolled, still troubleshooting SSH with Nina. Pixel says hi :parrot: — may contribute to #random later. Thanks everyone for the quick help!
